data.name: The Ice is Watching
data.detailed_description:
About This Game

The Ice is Watching is a first-person psychological horror experience that plunges you into a desolate, frozen nightmare. You don't play as a hero; you play as a woman driven by a single, desperate question: Where is he? As you trace your lover's last known location to a remote mountain cabin, the temperature drops, and the realization sets in you aren't alone. The Ice is here. And he’s been expecting you.

Break the Cycle

The journey begins in the artificial warmth of a city hotel, fueled by social media clues and hope. But as the rain turns to snow and the road disappears into white nothingness, the cycle of hope shatters. You reach the cabin only to find your escape sabotaged battery gone, tires missing. You are no longer the hunter; you are the next addition to a frozen collection. To break the cycle of death, you must face the man who watches from the shadows of the pines.

Gameplay Overview

Controlled through an immersive FPS perspective, the core experience focuses on Survival, Heat Management, and Stealth.

  • Thermal Survival: The cold is your primary enemy. Manage your body heat by scavenging wood and keeping the fireplace alive.

  • Stalker AI: "The Ice" the mysterious cowboy  is not a scripted jump scare. He observes, stalks, and hunts based on your movements and the noise you make.

  • Environmental Puzzle Solving: Scavenge for car parts to repair your vehicle while navigating a labyrinth of psychological traps and chilling audio tapes.

Key Features

  • Atmospheric Terror: Experience the immense scale of the snowy wilderness contrasted with the claustrophobic dread of a cabin that has seen too much.

  • Body Heat Mechanics: Feel the frost. As your temperature drops, your vision blurs, your breath quickens, and the environment becomes a lethal hallucination.

  • The Frozen Gallery: Discover the Frozen Lover a symbolic and narrative-driven encounter that explores themes of obsession and eternal preservation.

  • Immersive Soundscapes: High quality ambient 3D audio. From the creaking of floorboards to the metallic whisper of "The Ice" in the wind, sound is your only warning.

  • A Concise Nightmare: A story driven journey designed to be completed in one sitting (approx. 2 hours), leaving you with a lingering, frozen chill.

  • Stylized Gritty Visuals: A unique art style combining the rugged aesthetic of a dark Western with the cold, sterile beauty of an arctic grave.

data.short_description: One last GPS pin. One final hope. Following a GPS pin to the cabin, she thought she was coming for a rescue. She didn't know she was stepping into a frozen trap. Stranded and hunted by 'The Ice', you must keep the fire alive to survive the night. Uncover the chilling truth before you become his art
